0022600170.text: The Phoenix Suns (1-2, 11th in the West, 3rd in the Pacific and 2 games back) visit the Golden State Warriors (2-3, 10th in the West, 2nd in the Pacific and 2 games back) on the back of a loss, with Phoenix 0-2 on the road and Golden State riding a two-game winning streak. Mark Williams is out for Phoenix with a shoulder injury following surgery, while Golden State is missing Jimmy Butler III (knee surgery), Kristaps Porzingis (illness) and Moses Moody (knee surgery). The Suns lead the 2026-27 season series 1-0 after a 131-122 win in Phoenix on October 24, though they lost the 2025-26 series 1-3.
